# SphereAgent

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/agents/`](../folders/src-logic-agents.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/agents/sphere_roller.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/sphere_roller.h)

## Summary

The sphere_roll agent next to the sphere's Transform and RigidBody: task settings and episode state.

## Description

Exactly one entity per world is expected to carry SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody (sphere shape; half_extent.x is the radius); the systems use the first one of the view. Created from scene JSON (`SphereAgent` key, registered by registerSphereRoller with validation). The settings come from JSON; the episode state is written by resetSphereEpisode, SphereControlSys, SphereTaskSys and SphereObserveSys, and by steerSphere (RollerPlayer: VRRoller / DesktopRoller). The serializer writes back only the settings.

## Scene JSON

"SphereAgent": { "behavior", "max_torque", "speed_range", "stop_chance", "turn_rate", "acceleration", "goal_interval", "max_goal_turn", "home_radius", "bounds", "fall_depth", "spawn_radius", "spawn_spacing", "stagger", "reward_scale", "probe_distance", "max_decisions", "steered" } (validated: behavior non-empty, max_decisions >= 1, 0 <= speed_range.x <= speed_range.y, 0 < goal_interval.x <= goal_interval.y, reward_scale > 0)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `behavior` | `std::string` | "SphereRoller" | trainer behaviour name; must be non-empty |
| `max_torque` | `float` | 20 | N m for an action component of 1 |
| `speed_range` | `glm::vec2` | (0.5, 3) | target speeds, m/s; 0 <= min <= max |

| `home_radius` | `float` | 30 | beyond it from home, new goals point back (+-45 deg); 0 off |

| `fall_depth` | `float` | 100 | this far below home truncates the episode |

| `spawn_spacing` | `float` | 0 | world i spawns around (i * spawn_spacing, 0) |
| `stagger` | `bool` | true | on RESET start at a random decision count in [0, max_decisions) |
| `reward_scale` | `float` | 1 | r = exp(-\|v_xz - v*\| / reward_scale), m/s; must be > 0 |
| `probe_distance` | `float` | 1 | horizontal distance of the look-ahead ground normals, m |
| `max_decisions` | `int` | 600 | decisions per episode (not when steered); >= 1 |
| `steered` | `bool` | false | a player sets the goal (steerSphere): no goal draws, no time limit |

| `heading` | `float` | 0 | episode state: live target heading, rad (direction (cos h, 0, sin h)) |
| `speed` | `float` | 0 | episode state: live target speed, m/s |
| `goal_heading` | `float` | 0 | episode state: heading the target turns toward |
| `goal_speed` | `float` | 0 | episode state: speed the target accelerates toward |
| `goal_timer` | `float` | 0 | episode state: seconds until the next goal draw |
| `decision_target` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | episode state: target velocity of the last observation (rewards use it) |
| `decision_heading` | `float` | 0 | episode state: heading of the last observation (frame of the action torque) |
| `has_decision` | `bool` | false | episode state: an observation was sent this episode and the episode has not ended |
| `torque` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | episode state: world torque held over the window, N m |
| `reward_sum` | `double` | 0 | episode state: sum of per-tick rewards this window |
| `error_sum` | `double` | 0 | episode state: sum of \|v_xz - target\| this window |
| `reward_ticks` | `int` | 0 | episode state: ticks summed this window |
| `decisions` | `int` | 0 | episode state: observations sent this episode |
| `ended` | `bool` | false | episode state: episode over (time limit or out of bounds) |
| `out_of_bounds` | `bool` | false | episode state: ended by bounds / fall |
| `pending_reset` | `bool` | false | episode state: terminal observation sent, reset at the next window |
